notes.time: Routing only, with island positions held fixed; cold means no previous routing state.
notes.preservation: Bit-identical geometry among IDs present before and after the operation.
notes.memory: Approximate spatial-index and retained-state bytes from routing diagnostics, not process heap.
notes.quality: Base is this router's obstacle-selected arc before corridor separation; baseline is the optional saved old router on exactly the same geometry. baseline.routed measures additions/displacement relative to the old router; congestion.routed uses the new base arc. Lengths are world units.
